_comment: INVALID example — annotated with the specific violations for training/validation-test purposes. Remove _comment and _violations before using as a test fixture; they are not part of the schema (additionalProperties:false would reject them too).
_violations: trigger_type is 'cron' but both cron AND interval are set simultaneously — trigger types are mutually exclusive (violates Scheduler Contract §4 invariant / VAL-121)
timezone is missing entirely (violates Constitution §16.2 / VAL-124)
misfire_policy value 'ignore' is not one of catch_up|skip_if_missed (violates schema enum / VAL-125)
dependency.depends_on references this same job_name, forming a self-cycle (violates Scheduler Contract §4 invariant / VAL-127)
owner_ref.type is 'campaign' which is not a valid enum value (violates schema enum / VAL-129)
priority is 12, outside the 1-10 range (violates schema maximum:10 / VAL-131)
state is 'active' but execution_sla is missing, so SLA cannot be enforced (violates Scheduler Contract §2 required field / VAL-132)
